scope.purpose: Define what project and asset information is required, when it is required, the decisions it supports, its permitted use, delivery planning, and responsibility boundaries.
scope.boundary: S2 governs information demand and timing. S8 governs semantic structures, parameter/classification carriers, and asset schemas used to implement that demand.

missing_or_externalized_requirements.note: S2 scope references OIR, but no standalone governed OIR standard exists in BST.
EIR is present through BEP and delivery-core mechanisms rather than as a standalone S2 L4 standard.

provenance.migration_note: Primary machine-readable S2 baseline. Narrative baseline: page 2719824. Mature consolidated working specification: page 2588809. Standalone production standards are migrated as separate L4 child objects. The parent source is primarily structural, so no normative requirements are synthesized at this level.
